_doc: Kept only what Margarita may use: tone, power words (only those the brand would say), banned phrases (pass to preflight --banned), button shape and photo guidance. Removed on purpose: palettes and fonts (the user's palette and the site's fonts win), subject formulas with fake urgency, objection remedies with unsourced claims, and flow benchmarks that conflict with references/campaign-selection.md.

fashion_apparel.name: Fashion & Apparel
fashion_apparel.tone_of_voice: Understated confidence, curated taste, aspirational yet approachable.

photography.composition: Full-body context in natural ambient light followed by macro detail texture slice (fabric weave, ribbing, hardware)

beauty_skincare.name: Beauty & Skincare
beauty_skincare.tone_of_voice: Intimate best-friend energy backed by clinical dermatological clarity.

photography.composition: Formula texture swatch (dewy cream, golden oil drop, velvet foam) sitting directly adjacent to packaging bottle.

food_beverage.name: Food & Beverage
food_beverage.tone_of_voice: Witty, punchy, appetizing, self-aware, and anti-supermarket junk.

photography.composition: The Squeeze/Pour/Bite: Liquid mid-stream, cheese pull, or cereal bowl splash with genuine high-saturation ingredients.
The Living Vignette: Morning light through sheer curtains landing on rumpled linen sheets or a steaming cup next to cast iron.
The Kinetic Peak: Athlete mid-movement, muscle definition, water droplets repelling off DWR shell fabric.

pet_supplies.name: Pet Supplies & Lifestyle
pet_supplies.tone_of_voice: Humorous, devoted pet-parent perspective, playful, unconditional love.

photography.composition: The Happy Dog/Cat: Directly facing the camera with head tilted, interacting happily with the toy, harness, or meal bowl.
The Studio Exploded View: Ambient floating hardware with lighting catching anodized aluminum, matte polycarbonate, or laser-cut edges.

health_wellness.name: Health & Wellness
health_wellness.tone_of_voice: Authoritative, habit-focused, calm, transparent, scientifically backed.

photography.composition: The Morning Habit: Natural morning window light, scoop of green powder or amber tincture into clean glass of water.
